scope.business_name_en: DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS) – operated by The Depository Trust Company (DTC)
scope.business_name_zh: DTCC代币化服务（DTS）——由存托信托公司（DTC）运营
included: DTS tokenization and de-tokenization of eligible DTC-custodied securities (Russell 1000, U.S. Treasuries, major-index ETFs)
Registered Wallet controls, LedgerScan and Factory system operations
Canton Network and DTCC private Besu network integration
SEC No-Action Letter conditions and quarterly regulatory reporting obligations
Limited-production milestone trades (July 15, 2026) and full service launch (October 28, 2026)
Conversion-window operating hours and 24/7 token transfer rules
Network evaluation and selection framework for additional blockchain networks
DTC Participant onboarding (20 signed agreements at launch)
excluded: DDA (DTCC Digital Assets) technology products – distinct project business
NSCC and FICC clearing and settlement operations not directly touching DTS
Non-DTS DTCC products (ComposerX, Collateral AppChain, Digital Launchpad) except where they interact with DTS
Unrelated cryptocurrency exposures and non-DTC-custodied crypto assets
Private retail customer accounts (DTS is participant-only; retail effects are indirect)
Non-U.S. regulatory regimes except where cross-border participants are involved
date_limitations: SEC staff letter dated December11,2025; stated relief expires three years from launch of the Preliminary Base Version, subject to the letter conditions.
Public limited-production milestone: July15,2026; broader DTS launch announcement: October28,2026. These are distinct milestones.
No continuous DAS internal vulnerability/outcome series was obtained from the supplied documents; prelaunch simulation is counterfactual.
Original SEC PDF download returned403. A partial web-reader representation through approximately page10 was used, not the full39-page document.

facts.statement_en: DTS launched October 28, 2026 as a voluntary service enabling eligible DTC Participants to tokenize DTC-custodied securities.
facts.statement_zh: DTS于2026年10月28日正式上线，是一项自愿性服务，允许符合条件的DTC参与者对DTC托管证券进行代币化。
facts.evidence_quote: today launched the DTCC Tokenization Service (DTS)
facts.limitation: Launch announcement only; no post-launch operational metrics supplied.

facts.statement_en: Twenty DTC Participants signed agreements to access DTS at launch; future users to be onboarded on a rolling basis. Signed agreements are not confirmed active users.
facts.statement_zh: 上线时有20家DTC参与者签署了DTS接入协议；未来用户将滚动式入驻。签署协议不等于活跃用户。
facts.evidence_quote: 20 DTC Participants (clients) have signed agreements to access DTS
facts.limitation: Signed agreements ≠ active or transacting users; no active-user count found in supplied documents.

facts.statement_en: SEC Division of Trading and Markets staff issued a no-action position on December 11, 2025, covering Reg SCI, Exchange Act Section 19(b)/Rule 19b-4, and Rules 17Ad-22(e) and 17Ad-25(i)/(j) for the Preliminary Base Version. This is a staff no-action position, not blanket Commission approval.
facts.statement_zh: SEC交易与市场部门工作人员于2025年12月11日就初步基础版本发布不采取行动立场，涵盖Reg SCI等条款。这是工作人员立场，非委员会全面批准。
facts.evidence_quote: the Staff would not recommend enforcement
facts.limitation: Partial web-reader extract of pages 0–10 of a 39-page PDF; full document not directly accessible. Staff position subject to modification or revocation at any time.

facts.statement_en: Eligible securities include Russell1000 constituents at pilot launch and later additions (including subsequent index removals), U.S. Treasury bills/bonds/notes, and ETFs tracking major indices.
facts.statement_zh: 合格证券包括试点上线时的罗素1000成分股及其后新增证券（即使其后被移出指数）、美国国债及追踪主要指数的ETF。
facts.evidence_quote: limited to (i) securities in the Russell 1000 Index
facts.limitation: The letter expressly preserves eligibility despite subsequent Russell1000 index removal; index removal alone must not be coded as loss of eligibility.

facts.statement_en: DTC will not ascribe collateral value or settlement value to any Tokenized Entitlements for purposes of DTC risk management, including Net Debit Cap or Collateral Monitor calculations.
facts.statement_zh: DTC不会将任何代币化权益赋予抵押品价值或结算价值，不用于DTC风险管理（包括净借记上限或抵押品监控）计算。
facts.limitation: This is a DTC internal risk management restriction; external CCP collateral workflows using tokenized assets are a separate matter not precluded by this restriction.

facts.statement_en: LedgerScan and Factory are designated Tier 2 systems with a four-hour recovery time objective, two-minute maximum data loss, and annual out-of-region DR testing. They are physically and logically separate from DTC's SCI clearing/settlement systems.
facts.statement_zh: LedgerScan和Factory被指定为二级系统，恢复时间目标为四小时，最大数据丢失两分钟，并须进行年度异地灾难恢复测试，且与DTC的SCI清算/结算系统物理和逻辑隔离。
facts.evidence_quote: a maximum of a four-hour recovery time objective
facts.limitation: These are design commitments stated in the no-action request; actual tested recovery performance not reported in supplied documents.

facts.statement_en: Tokens are only transferable to Registered Wallets of DTC Participants. DTC retains technological capability to transfer tokens to address Conditions Requiring Reversal (erroneous entries, lost tokens, malfeasance).
facts.statement_zh: 代币仅可转移至DTC参与者的已注册钱包。DTC保留技术能力，可在满足"需要撤销条件"时（错误记录、丢失代币、不当行为）转移代币。
facts.evidence_quote: Tokens are only transferrable to Registered Wallets
facts.limitation: Reversal capability is a design commitment; frequency or success rate of reversals not found in supplied documents.

facts.statement_en: Conversion orders (tokenization/de-tokenization) may be submitted Monday–Friday 2:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. ET; token transfers between Registered Wallets may occur 24/7.
facts.statement_zh: 转换指令（代币化/去代币化）可在周一至周五美东时间凌晨2点至下午6点提交；已注册钱包之间的代币转移可全天候进行。
facts.evidence_quote: orders) may be submitted to DTC Monday through Friday between 2:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m.
facts.limitation: Operating window is a policy parameter; actual conversion volumes and queue depths not available.

chains.name_zh: 网络/系统韧性——DTS基础设施中断
chains.external_shock: Sustained outage of Canton Network, DTCC private Besu network, or LedgerScan/Factory cloud infrastructure during peak conversion demand
chains.transmission_pathway_en: Network or DTS system unavailability may delay conversion orders or token transfers; participants relying on timely conversion or collateral movement could experience operational delays. System separation is a control intended to limit propagation; core-DTC disruption or participant losses are not automatic and have not been observed here.
chains.transmission_pathway_zh: 网络或DTS系统不可用可能延迟转换指令或代币转移，使依赖及时转换或抵押品移动的参与者出现运营延误。系统隔离旨在限制影响扩散；不能直接推定核心DTC系统中断或参与者发生损失。
chains.mechanism_evidence_quote: a maximum of a four-hour recovery time objective
chains.proposed_internal_buffer_metric: Tested failover capacity / peak required conversion throughput (ratio): proportion of peak conversion-order volume that can be processed from the secondary location within the RTO window
chains.exact_data_needed: Actual tested secondary-site throughput records; peak conversion-order submission rates; LedgerScan/Factory DR test results
chains.public_external_information_to_collect: Canton Network and LFDT Besu public status/incident logs (note: private Besu uptime is not directly observable from public Ethereum or Canton public metrics); cloud provider SLA disclosures for LedgerScan hosting
chains.simulation_limits: Assumption-based sensitivity testing only; no empirical DTS throughput or outage history available; private Besu uptime cannot be proxied by public network data
chains.public_driver_candidate: Canton Network public status page; LFDT Besu release/incident history – weak proxy for private DTS infrastructure
chains.validation_needed: Obtain DR test reports, secondary-site capacity benchmarks, and actual conversion-order volume data from DTC operations

chains.name_zh: 记录/对账——LedgerScan账本偏差风险
chains.external_shock: Blockchain reorganization, smart-contract bug, or cloud-hosted LedgerScan data corruption causes divergence between on-chain token balances and DTC's official books and records
chains.transmission_pathway_en: A mismatch between LedgerScan records and on-chain state could require reconciliation or controlled correction; unresolved backlog could delay entitlement processing and affect DTC quarterly reporting to SEC staff. This is a conditional hypothesis; DTC bears the reporting commitment and published outcomes were not obtained.
chains.transmission_pathway_zh: LedgerScan记录与链上状态不一致可能需要对账或受控更正；积压可能延迟权益处理，并影响DTC向SEC工作人员提交的季度报告。这是条件性假设；报告承诺由DTC承担，尚未取得公开实测结果。
chains.mechanism_evidence_quote: would constitute DTC’s official books and records.
chains.proposed_internal_buffer_metric: Reconciliation-resolution capacity / peak unresolved backlog (ratio): maximum number of divergence cases resolvable per day divided by peak observed or stress-assumed unresolved cases
chains.exact_data_needed: LedgerScan reconciliation throughput benchmarks; historical count of Conditions Requiring Reversal invocations; root-wallet resolution turnaround times
chains.public_external_information_to_collect: Public blockchain reorganization frequency for Canton and Besu networks; ERC-3643 smart-contract audit reports
chains.simulation_limits: No empirical reconciliation backlog data available; simulation is assumption-based only; root-wallet usage frequency not found in supplied documents
chains.public_driver_candidate: Canton Network block finality statistics; LFDT Besu chain reorganization records – weak proxy; private chain behavior may differ
chains.validation_needed: Obtain DTC internal reconciliation SLA data, root-wallet invocation logs, and LedgerScan audit trail records

chains.name_en: Wallet/Security – Registered Wallet Compromise or OFAC Screening Failure
chains.name_zh: 钱包/安全——已注册钱包被攻击或OFAC筛查失效
chains.external_shock: Private-key compromise of a DTC Participant's Registered Wallet, or failure of DTC's OFAC screening to detect a sanctioned address prior to wallet registration
chains.transmission_pathway_en: Compromised wallet allows unauthorized token transfers between Registered Wallets → DTC's LedgerScan detects movement but reversal requires root-wallet intervention → delay in reversal creates window of disputed ownership → if OFAC screening failed, DTC and participant face sanctions exposure; Registered Wallet restriction limits transfers to allowlisted addresses, reducing but not eliminating risk of unauthorized movement.
chains.transmission_pathway_zh: 钱包私钥泄露导致代币在已注册钱包间被未授权转移→LedgerScan检测到转移但撤销需根钱包介入→撤销延迟造成所有权争议窗口→若OFAC筛查失效，DTC及参与者面临制裁风险；已注册钱包限制降低但不能完全消除未授权转移风险。
chains.mechanism_evidence_quote: Tokens are only transferrable to Registered Wallets
chains.proposed_internal_buffer_metric: Tokenized assets under verified multi-party control / total DTS tokenized assets (ratio): share of tokenized positions held in wallets with confirmed multi-party or institutional-grade key management
chains.exact_data_needed: Wallet custodian key-management attestations; proportion of Registered Wallets using multi-party computation or HSM controls; OFAC re-screening frequency
chains.public_external_information_to_collect: Public security audit reports for named wallet collaborators (BitGo, Fireblocks, DFNS, Taurus, Blockdaemon); OFAC SDN list update frequency
chains.simulation_limits: Named collaborators are not confirmed approved custodians per supplied documents; no empirical wallet-compromise incident data available; simulation is assumption-based only
chains.public_driver_candidate: Public security incident disclosures from wallet infrastructure providers – weak context; private DTS wallet security is not directly observable
chains.validation_needed: Confirm approved wallet custodian list from DTC; obtain key-management attestations and OFAC screening process documentation

chains.name_en: Eligibility/Regulation – SEC No-Action Withdrawal or Eligibility Boundary Breach
chains.name_zh: 资格/监管——SEC不采取行动立场撤销或资格边界违反
chains.external_shock: SEC staff changes its no-action position or the service authorization approaches expiry; actual violations of permitted asset/participant conditions could also trigger review. Subsequent Russell1000 index removal alone is not a disqualifying event.
chains.transmission_pathway_en: A change in applicable regulatory conditions could require service restrictions, rule filings or contingency conversion, depending on official instructions. Capacity relative to affected positions determines the hypothetical adjustment burden. Neither forced conversion nor an enforcement action is assumed to occur automatically.
chains.transmission_pathway_zh: 适用监管条件改变，可能按官方要求触发服务限制、规则备案或应急转换；转换能力相对于受影响头寸的规模决定假设中的调整负担。不能直接认定会强制转换或发生执法行动。
chains.mechanism_evidence_quote: without further action three years from the date DTC launches operation of the Preliminary Base
chains.proposed_internal_buffer_metric: Contingency de-tokenization capacity / affected tokenized positions (ratio): maximum number of positions DTC can de-tokenize per day under contingency procedures divided by total tokenized positions outstanding
chains.exact_data_needed: DTC contingency de-tokenization throughput benchmarks; current total tokenized positions outstanding; eligibility monitoring process documentation
chains.public_external_information_to_collect: SEC rulemaking activity on tokenization; FSOC SIFMU oversight communications; Russell 1000 index constituent change announcements
chains.simulation_limits: No empirical de-tokenization volume data available; regulatory revocation probability is not quantifiable from supplied documents; simulation is assumption-based sensitivity testing only
chains.public_driver_candidate: SEC public rulemaking calendar and no-action letter modification precedents – weak context for DTS-specific probability
chains.validation_needed: Obtain DTC contingency de-tokenization runbook; confirm eligibility monitoring controls and index-change notification procedures

chains.name_en: Conversion/Corporate-Action Capacity – Window Congestion and Corporate Action Processing
chains.name_zh: 转换/公司行动容量——窗口拥堵与公司行动处理
chains.external_shock: Surge in conversion-order submissions (e.g., market stress, index rebalancing) or a complex corporate action (dividend, merger) affecting tokenized securities overwhelms DTS processing capacity within the operating window
chains.transmission_pathway_en: Peak conversion demand above processing capacity could produce queues and delay participant workflows. Corporate-action payment errors could require correction. The letter permits two limited interfaces to core DTC: securities movements to/from the Digital Omnibus Account and corporate-action cash payments; cash payment is not the sole permitted interface. No processing failure has been established by this research.
chains.transmission_pathway_zh: 峰值转换需求超过处理能力可能形成队列并延迟参与者工作流；公司行动支付错误可能需要更正。函件允许两类与DTC核心系统的有限接口：数字总括账户证券转入转出，以及公司行动现金支付，后者并非唯一接口。本次研究未证实已经发生处理失败。
chains.mechanism_evidence_quote: make a cash payment from a corporate action event
chains.proposed_internal_buffer_metric: Conversion capacity / peak conversion demand (ratio): maximum Factory throughput (conversion orders per hour) divided by peak observed or stress-assumed submission rate
chains.exact_data_needed: Factory system throughput benchmarks (orders per hour); historical or stress-scenario peak conversion-order submission rates; corporate action processing error rates for tokenized positions
chains.public_external_information_to_collect: Russell 1000 and major-index rebalancing calendars (public); U.S. Treasury auction and maturity schedules; historical DTC corporate action volumes for eligible securities
chains.simulation_limits: No empirical DTS conversion volume data available; Factory throughput limits not disclosed in supplied documents; simulation is assumption-based functional testing only
chains.public_driver_candidate: Index rebalancing dates and Treasury auction calendars are public and could drive stress-scenario timing assumptions – moderate relevance as external demand proxies
chains.validation_needed: Obtain Factory capacity benchmarks, conversion-order queue management procedures, and corporate action reconciliation controls documentation

recommended_next_steps_en: Request actual Factory/LedgerScan capacity, DR-test results, conversion demand and reconciliation records; these populate the five protective-buffer ratios.
Confirm Registered Wallet control attestations and approved infrastructure directly with DTC; named collaborators do not establish deployment or approval.
Confirm the formal Preliminary Base Version commencement date and relief expiry with DTC rather than deriving expiry from a production milestone.
Assess actual public-proxy series separately from internal measurements. Do not substitute market stress or generic crypto prices automatically for DAS V.
Use assumption-based functional/sensitivity tests only with explicit labels; these do not calibrate or empirically validate real DAS risk.
Extend a dedicated reviewed DAS news/card schema before any production classification; preserve the original final16 catalog.
recommended_next_steps_zh: 索取Factory/LedgerScan处理能力、灾难恢复测试、转换需求和对账记录，用来填写五条链的保护性缓冲比率。
向DTC确认已注册钱包控制证明与实际部署的基础设施；合作机构名单不代表部署或批准清单。
向DTC确认初步基础版本的正式启动日及不采取行动立场的到期日，不从单次生产演示直接推定。
把真实公开代理序列与内部实测数据分开评估；不能直接把市场冲击或泛化币价用作DAS的V。
假设模拟仅用于流程和敏感性测试，须明确标注，不能据此声称已校准或实证验证DAS风险。
先建立可审核的DAS新闻与卡片schema，再接入生产分类；保留原有final16目录。
cannot_empirically_validate_yet: All five proposed buffer ratios (DAS-01 through DAS-05): no operational throughput, volume, or incident data found in supplied documents.
Active user count vs. signed-agreement count: 20 signed agreements at launch; no confirmed active transacting participant count available.
LedgerScan reconciliation performance: no divergence frequency, resolution time, or root-wallet invocation count found.
Factory conversion throughput limits: not disclosed in any supplied document.
Wallet security posture of named collaborators: named firms are not confirmed approved custodians per supplied documents.
Post-launch DTS operating metrics (volumes, wallet counts, outage durations): not yet available; quarterly SEC reports are the designated source but none have been published.
Any synthetic vulnerability series for 2020Q4–2026Q2 would be entirely counterfactual/pre-launch and must not be treated as observed DAS operating history.
Private Besu and Canton Network uptime as experienced by DTS: not observable from public network statistics.
